name: Backward Mapping (Ray Tracing)
definition: A volumetric rendering technique that uses computer graphics ray-tracing to form the image. For each pixel, a ray is projected through the data volume, and intersecting voxels influence the pixel value.
summary: Backward mapping is an image-space volume rendering technique that projects rays from pixels through volumetric data to accumulate voxel values, producing fuzzy images that reduce misinterpretations inherent in crisp surface renderings.
